name: NeurIPS 2024 LLM Privacy Challenge
description: A competition to explore vulnerabilities and defenses in Large Language Models (LLMs), focusing on privacy preservation, model utility, and computational efficiency.

cr:input.name: competition_dataset
cr:input.description: Participants receive queries or prompts to interact with LLMs fine-tuned on synthetic private data. For the Red Team, the input is designed to extract sensitive information, while for the Blue Team, the input includes the same LLMs with the ability to apply defense mechanisms.

cr:output.name: predictions
cr:output.description: For the Red Team, the output includes extracted sensitive information or indicators of successful breaches. For the Blue Team, the output includes enhanced LLMs or structured reports detailing the applied defenses.

field.name: id
field.description: unique identifier for the sample, e.g., query_001 or defense_001

field.name: pred
field.description: output sensitive information (Red Team) or a description of the defense mechanism applied (Blue Team)

cr:evaluation.notes: Attack Accuracy is higher-is-better for the Red Team but lower-is-better for the Blue Team. Efficiency is measured as fewer tokens or computational overhead being better. Model Effectiveness ensures minimal degradation in LLM utility.

open_questions: What are the exact formats and value ranges for the outputs of both tracks?
